Risks.Description: The system may receive prompts requesting self-harm, violence, or physical harm instructions.
Risks.Treatment: Block at InputValidator, audit, and return a safe blocked decision.

Risks.Description: Users may attempt to override instructions, leak hidden prompts, or bypass policy.
Risks.Treatment: Detect in InputValidator, score in RiskAnalyzer, route to human review.

Risks.Description: Prompts or outputs may contain personal data, credentials, secrets, or regulated information.
Risks.Treatment: Review sensitive input and redact sensitive output patterns.

Risks.Description: The system may be used to support discriminatory or protected-class decisions.
Risks.Treatment: Detect protected-class terms, route to human review, and audit the decision.

Risks.Description: AI provider, model, dependency, or configuration changes may introduce security or governance risk.
Risks.Treatment: Track provider and model metadata, externalize connector settings, and review dependencies before production.

Risks.Description: AI output may contain unsafe instructions, secrets, or content unsafe to pass to downstream systems.
Risks.Treatment: Sanitize output before returning to the caller and audit applied controls.

Risks.Description: Large prompts, repeated requests, or expensive model calls can create cost and availability risk.
Risks.Treatment: Limit prompt length now; add tenant rate limits and model budget controls before production.

Risks.Description: If the organization provides or significantly modifies a GPAI model, EU AI Act provider obligations may apply.
Risks.Treatment: Maintain model documentation, copyright policy evidence, training-content summaries, systemic risk reviews, and incident records outside the gateway.
